name: Decolonizing Mass Incarceration: “Flesh Will Wear Out Chains”
headline: Decolonizing Mass Incarceration: “Flesh Will Wear Out Chains”
description: The author argues that the kind of flesh of people who bear the chains of U.S. mass incarceration is a flesh that takes itself as vulnerable human being, but which transforms its vulnerable agonism into artistic practices into modes of collective organization.
